11. FAQ

1. Q: What is the actual diameter of a 5-inch well pump? Will it fit inside my 5" diameter well casing?

A:The diameter of 125QJD 5" submersible well pump is 125mm. It will definitely fit in a straight 5’’ well properly.

2. Q: Is customized service available?

3. Q: How far down could I put the pump in the well?

A: The pump needs to be set at a depth that is a minimum of 5’ off the bottom of the well. If your well has a sandy bottom, in order to prevent the pump from picking up sand, it should be set more like 15’ to 20’ off the bottom.
